result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional, but the horizontal restaurant carousel ('Fastest near you') clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right screen edge, truncating its name and image. This is expected carousel behavior but the truncated title reads as visually broken. No critical or functional defects were found.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with both the image and the restaurant name truncated mid-word.
issues.suggestion: This is acceptable for a horizontally scrollable carousel, but add a subtle right-edge fade/gradient or peek padding so the cut-off clearly signals scrollability rather than looking like a layout bug. Ensure the full name is reachable by scrolling.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without a clear affordance that more text exists, which can look like broken text.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent ellipsis truncation with a fixed max-width, or wrap to two lines, so truncated titles look intentional.
